notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column (p6); business-type from proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position Total Enterprise Funds column (p10; internal service fund excluded). Business-type receipts = operating revenues + investment earnings; interest expense, net shown as a disbursement (nonoperating net total 909,708 = 1,786,188 - 876,480); business-type net position beginning is as printed before restatement, restatement -276,433 recorded as adjustment. Business-type operating expenses are listed by cost type: category is the cost type with function utilities (utility bills 'Heat, light and power, phone' and 'Landfill disposal' stay utilities; 'Other operating' is other). SBITA proceeds 10,031 placed in debt_proceeds. ending_cash is cash and cash equivalents only (p4); cash at county treasurer 510,105 and investments 17,025,046 shown separately on the balance sheet (ending_investments). Balance sheet uses government-wide total column (p1); compensated absences lines are category Compensated Absences (Due Within One Year / Due in More Than One Year, printed text in printed_label); deferred inflows related to leases are Deferred Inflows for Leases. Budget-basis schedules (pp13-16) differ from GAAP actuals; General, Streets/Engineering, Sales Tax and 1/2 Sales Tax funds recorded from budget-and-actual schedules (Sales Tax fund page prints no expenditures; its transfers shown as net). Nonmajor combining statement has 13 funds (pp17-19) so the Total Other Governmental column (p19) is used as Nonmajor funds (combined). Transfers net on budget schedules are shown as one printed line. Attempt 3 (2026-10-28 re-check): utility cost-type functions, compensated absences categories, nonmajor fund count. Read pages 1-19 of 19
